caption: The vents on a charcoal grill's bowl are slid shut, and the bright orange coals dim to a dull glow.

sa.check: A charcoal grill with glowing coals and vents on its bowl.
The coals end at a dull glow.
The coals are bright orange before the vents close.
The order is bright, vents shut, dimmer.

pc.expect: The glow begins to fade after the vents are slid shut and not before.
pc.fail: The glow fades before the vents are touched; or the vents are shut and the coals stay bright orange to the end of the clip; or the coals brighten after the vents are shut; or the glow fades while the vents are being opened.

pc.expect: The fade runs one way while the vents stay shut and the coals do not flare back up.
pc.fail: The coals flare up again with the vents still shut; or the glow fades and brightens in turn; or the coals go dark in a single frame; or the ash gathers back into unburnt charcoal.

pc.expect: Any smoke from the coals rises and escapes where it can, and ash settles down in the bowl.
pc.fail: The smoke sinks into the bowl and pools; or pours downward out of the grill's base; or ash rises and stays aloft; or the smoke hangs as a fixed shape without rising.

pc.expect: The coals stay hard lumps that dull and crust with ash, and the vents stay rigid sliding plates.
pc.fail: A coal melts or flows; or the coals swell as they dim; or a vent bends as it is slid; or the ash holds a rigid shape when the grill is knocked.

pc.expect: The coals keep their number in the bowl, dulling rather than vanishing, and the vents stay on the grill.
pc.fail: A coal vanishes leaving no ash; or new coals appear with none added; or a vent vanishes; or the bowl changes shape.

pc.expect: The grill's body, its legs and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The grill changes colour; or a leg changes shape; or items around the grill rearrange.

note: How far the glow has faded by the end of the clip is not judged, only that it fades one way after the vents shut.
